Name: Sopater
Summary: Sopater of Berea accompanied Paul toward Jerusalem with the collection for the saints. He is traditionally identified with Sosipater, greeted in the later epistles, though Acts names him Sopater.
KeyStory: Sopater of Berea travelled with Paul's company toward Jerusalem, carrying the gift of the churches.
LifeLesson: Berea's nobility bore fruit in a travelling companion. Sopater carried more than luggage to Jerusalem.
